title: TCM-Eval: An Expert-Level Dynamic and Extensible Benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine
reasoning: The paper introduces a medical knowledge benchmark (TCM-Eval) based on national licensing examinations for Traditional Chinese Medicine. While it includes domains such as 'TCM Ethics' and 'Medical Humanities', these sub-categories evaluate professional medical conduct, legal regulations, and clinical ethics (e.g., counterfeit drugs) rather than religion, theology, or general moral/ethical systems in a religious or philosophical sense.
